ticket: Let a requester opt out of satisfaction surveys entirely.
notes: shouldSendSurvey has no per-requester preference check at all -- only a per-ticket surveySentAt guard. There is no requester/customer preference record anywhere in this fixture.

criticalAmbiguities.description: There is no requester preference record of any kind; opt-out needs a new data model, not a flag on an existing type.
Opt out of all surveys forever, or just skip one ticket at a time.
Whether only the requester or also an agent/admin can set the opt-out.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Assuming a requester preference record already exists.
